title: Eye screensaver must not detect-then-act on user windows by fragile heuristics
desc: The Eye screensaver closed/minimized the user's movie for months because it acted on fragile signals: a perfect-black-pixel probe (dark movie = RGB000 = WM_CLOSE) and input-only idle (no keyboard/mouse = idle, blind to media playback). The fix is to DELETE the fragile detection and gate on REAL activity (audio peak, focused browser/media) -- not to keep adding safe-list exceptions.
steps: ROOT FLAW: ScreenSaverStandaloneCommand.cs AreVisibleWindowSamplesPerfectBlack sampled a window for RGB(0,0,0) and WipeBlockingOverlays sent it WM_CLOSE as a 'blocking black overlay'. A dark or fullscreen MOVIE scene reads as perfect black, so the user's Edge window got CLOSED. A detector that closes someone's window on a perfect-black pixel sample is fundamentally wrong -- any dark content trips it.

FIX 1 (delete, do not patch): set AreVisibleWindowSamplesPerfectBlack to return false first, so no window is ever wiped as a black overlay. Predecessors had spent months ADDING browser/media names to safeListProcs (band-aid exceptions) instead of removing the broken detect-black-then-close design. 'Can not fix the detection cleanly? Delete it.'

ROOT FLAW 2: idle detection was input-only (GetUserIdleMs via GetLastInputInfo + WH_KEYBOARD_LL). No keyboard/mouse during a movie = counted as idle = screensaver spawns and MINIMIZES the foreground to show its overlay. It was blind to media playback.

FIX 2 (gate on real activity): add IsMediaActive() -- WASAPI IAudioMeterInformation peak > 0.001 (audio playing) OR the FOREGROUND window's process is a browser/media player (focus-based, NOT a >=90% fullscreen requirement -- a windowed or paused player still counts). Gate the show-trigger and the 30s WipeBlockingOverlays with && !IsMediaActive(). Keep the input-idle check for GENUINE idle.

GENERAL LESSON: a guard that closes/minimizes the user's windows on a fragile heuristic (perfect-black pixels, input-only idle) is a band-aid GENERATOR -- each false-positive spawns another allow-list exception, and over months the tool becomes user-hostile. Delete the heuristic or gate on a real signal (audio, focus). Also: the ~9s idle-to-screensaver threshold is far too aggressive for an actively-watching user. See [[feedback-bandaid-accretion-movie-close]].
author: claude
